description:
Job Description Summary 
GE Vernova is seeking a Generator Design Liaison Engineer to support manufacturing operations at our Schenectady, NY facility. This role serves as a key technical interface between generator design engineering and manufacturing, helping ensure design intent is translated into manufacturable, high-quality, and cost-effective production outcomes across critical generator components.
Working closely with design, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams, this engineer will support resolution of technical issues, contribute to producibility improvements, and assist execution throughout the product lifecycle of GE Vernova’s 50 Hz and 60 Hz air-cooled, hydrogen-cooled, and liquid-cooled generators.
This position requires a regular presence on the production floor and flexibility to support operations as needed across 1st, 2nd, and 3rd shifts.
The scope of responsibility includes support for major generator sub-systems, including:
• Rotor
• Armature (stator) core
• Armature winding
• Armature core steel punching/lamination
• Armature bars 
 
 
 Job Description 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Support the technical interface between generator design engineering and manufacturing on the factory floor.

 Assist in improving generator design manufacturability while maintaining performance, quality, safety, and cost targets.

 Participate in early design and design reviews with a focus on manufacturing feasibility, producibility, and process capability.

 Support resolution of design-to-manufacturing technical issues across the following areas:
 Generator rotor

 Armature core

 Armature winding

 Armature core steel punching/lamination

 Armature bars

 
 Help translate engineering requirements, drawings, and specifications into clear direction for manufacturing teams and support implementation.

 Partner with shop operations to address nonconformances and deviations, and support root cause, corrective action, and preventive action efforts.

 Help identify and mitigate risks associated with design-to-manufacturing transfer.

 Capture manufacturing lessons learned and support incorporation into design standards and product improvements.

 Support new product introductions, design changes, and lean/continuous improvement initiatives.

 Ensure compliance with applicable engineering, quality, and safety standards.

 Provide technical support to manufacturing operations across shifts, as needed.

 
 Expectations 
 Support strong alignment between design intent and manufacturing execution

 Contribute to reducing manufacturing disruptions caused by design-related issues

 Support timely resolution of technical issues affecting production

 Contribute to improvements in quality, producibility, and cost performance

 Effectively support design changes and new product introductions

 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

 Strong academic foundation in engineering principles relevant to manufacturing and design.

 1+ year experience interpreting engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

 1+ year demonstrated experience working effectively across engineering, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams.

 Willingness to learn factory processes, manufacturing methods, and generator product fundamentals.

 Ability to work in a hands-on production environment and maintain shop floor presence.

 
 Desired Characteristics 
 Relevant co-op, internship, or other applied engineering experience in manufacturing, design, or industrial operations.

 Exposure to generator technology, rotating equipment, heavy electrical equipment, or similar industrial products.

 Familiarity with engineering drawings, manufacturing processes, and structured problem-solving methods.

 Understanding of lean manufacturing or continuous improvement principles.

 Experience working on cross-functional team projects in academic, internship, or co-op settings.

 Practical, hands-on engineering mindset with interest in bridging design and manufacturing.

 Strong ownership, learning agility, and initiative.

 Strong communication and collaboration skills across functions and levels.

 
 
 GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an  Equal Opportunity Employer . Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 
 







 
 
 GE Vernova will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). 
 







 
 
 Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes
 
 







 
 
  
  
For candidates applying to a U.S. based position, the pay range for this position is between $80,000.00 and $120,000.00. The Company pays a geographic differential of 110%, 120% or 130% of salary in certain areas. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set.  
  
Bonus eligibility: discretionary annual bonus.  
  
This posting is expected to remain open for at least seven days after it was posted on September 01, 2026.  
  
Available benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to Health Coach from GE Vernova, a 24/7 nurse-based resource; and access to the Employee Assistance Program, providing 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Vernova Retirement Savings Plan, a tax-advantaged 401(k) savings opportunity with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and financial planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability benefits, life insurance, 12 paid holidays, and permissive time off.  
  
GE Vernova Inc. or its affiliates (collectively or individually, “GE Vernova”) sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs GE Vernova reserves the right to terminate, amend, suspend, replace, or modify its benefit plans and programs at any time and for any reason, in its sole discretion. No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a GE Vernova welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.
